messages:
maria: Quick ping — opened PR #1179 with a tiny rename (kv_cache -> kvstore) + a few lint fixes in runtime/http. Tests updated. Need one approval before I merge; CI is a bit flaky so I'd rather not queue a rerun without an LGTM. cc @alex for a quick look

alex: I can look now. Quick Q: does the rename touch any exported APIs or config?

maria: only internal packages under runtime/http and a couple of test helpers. No public API surface. The rename is to match the rest of the repo (we have other packages using "kvstore").

devon: left a tiny nit in the review about a short helper name (GetKV -> Get). Not blocking. Also run `make format` — saw a couple of spacing diffs locally.

maria: thanks — ran `make format` and pushed a follow-up commit. Also fixed the test helper name per your suggestion.

ci-bot: CI started for PR #1179 — running unit, integration, and lint pipelines.

alex: quick pass done, nothing major. One suggestion: rename the variable `store` -> `kv` in runtime/http/handler.go to be more explicit about type. Not blocking for me though. Approved.

maria: appreciated. I'll take the var rename in a follow-up tiny PR if that's ok (to keep this change scope minimal).

devon: no objections — that sounds fine. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: CI passed for PR #1179 — unit: ✅ integration: ✅ lint: ✅

jin: if everyone's happy I can merge once the branch protection checks are green. Do you want me to squash and merge or merge commit?

maria: please squash (single commit). small change.

jin: done — squashed & merged. Release notes: internal rename, no user-facing changes.

maria: thanks everyone! If a follow-up var rename is needed I'll open a new small PR.

alex: thanks for handling the flakiness check — nice to avoid unnecessary reruns.

maria: yup — appreciate the quick reviews :heart:
